pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free ($0, 1,000 credits/month), Core ($12/month), Pro ($21/month), and Teams ($38/month), each based around a 10,000-credit monthly allowance… Make's pricing page defaults to the annual toggle, where Core at 10,000 credits is $12/month. Billed month to month, the same plan is $16."

nl.tagline: Visuele automatisering van het Tsjechische Make, voordelig op volume
nl.description: Make (voorheen Integromat, uit Praag) laat je complexe automatiseringen visueel bouwen met vertakkingen, lussen en AI-stappen. Per uitgevoerde handeling voordeliger dan Zapier, met een iets steilere leercurve.
notFor: Absolute beginners die één simpele koppeling willen
limitations: Credits per maand; AI-functies verbruiken credits anders dan gewone stappen

en.tagline: Visual automation from Czech company Make, cost-effective at volume
en.description: Make (formerly Integromat, from Prague) lets you build complex automations visually with branches, loops and AI steps. Cheaper per operation than Zapier, with a slightly steeper learning curve.
bestFor: People who prefer a European provider
notFor: Absolute beginners wanting one simple connection
limitations: Monthly credits; AI features consume credits differently
